title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.52
summary: Clearer episode details, readable title artwork and retained browsing caches after playback.

sections.heading: Readable title and episode details
bullets: Very dark cached title logos fall back to the existing readable text title. Bright and colorful logos keep their artwork.
Episode metadata has room for the full air-date year and a separate watched indicator.

sections.heading: Retained browsing after playback
bullets: Neutral Home and public-row snapshots retain their original age after playback while watched and resume metadata refresh. Account and layout changes retain full cache invalidation.
First visits, expired displays and provider outages continue through the normal provider path.

sections.heading: Focused episode source improvement
bullets: Two reviewed stateless CocoScrapers providers overlap numbered and air-date queries, retaining primary-first order, deduplication, filters, ranking and timeouts. Results and timing depend on the provider and episode.
Installer1.0.48 verifies the complete reviewed CocoScrapers source and protects it from ordinary bulk replacement.

sections.heading: Preserved settings and compatibility
bullets: In-place updates retain accounts, preferences, saved data and unrelated addons. Standard and Clean retain their established selected-data and reset behavior.
Both edition playback differences, prior privacy and reliability fixes, current Helper sync providers and branded icon packs remain included.
